data.name: Bound to Rot
data.detailed_description:
Bound to Rot is a dark fantasy action RPG built around one ruthless question: how far can an angel descend before the mortal vessel carrying them rots away?

You are an angel, a soul reborn into a Vessel of your choosing. Each descent into the Anima is a gamble of flesh and fate: clear rooms, gather rare gear, and push deeper... or turn back while your body still holds. Stray too far from the Pulse, linger too long, and the darkness will collect what you owe.

Die, and the vessel is gone. Everything. Gone.

An Angel in a Mortal Vessel

Reincarnate as a Myronian warrior, a Theran fighter, or a Pyrrhian knight, each vessel carries a passive gift of its own. New vessels unlock as your soul proves itself in the deep. The soul endures. The vessel does not. The deeper you fall, the faster it rots.

The Pulse and the Tarot

Every room you clear, the Pulse deals a four-card Major Arcana spread, face-down. Flip them one by one. Each card carries a direction, descend deeper, hold your ground, rise toward the light, or return to the Hub with your spoils, plus a boon or bane that reshapes the next room, and a reward that only drops if you survive what follows. The World always lets you leave. Death always tempts you deeper.

Itemization That Actually Matters

Six damage types. Hundreds of affixes. A spatial grid inventory that forces real decisions about what you carry out.

Items roll on drop and never change, what you find is what you get. Common scrap or a Legendary with a unique red-text mod that rewrites how your build works.

Dark, Deterministic Combat

Hit resolution runs through an Entropy System, no pure RNG streaks, no invisible dice rolls. Accuracy, evasion, and per-entity entropy values produce combat that feels fair even when it kills you.

Seasonal Ladders

Every season wipes the slate. Climb the competitive ladder, race to depth, and carve your name into the rankings before the reset erases everything and the cycle begins again.

Features

  • Play an angel reincarnated into a mortal vessel

  • Three vessels, Myronian, Theran, Pyrrhian, each with its own passive with many more to come

  • Tarot card decisions at the Pulse: every card gambles on the next room

  • Permadeath! lose your vessel, not just your loot

  • Extract between nodes or risk it all pushing deeper

  • Diablo II-inspired itemization: five rarity tiers, prefix/suffix affixes, spatial inventory

  • Six damage types with distinct mechanics (Burning, Chain Lightning, Freeze, Rot)

  • Deterministic hit system, no streaky RNG

  • Seasonal resets with competitive ladders

  • Dark fantasy gothic aesthetic

data.short_description: Play as an angel reincarnated into a mortal vessel. Descend into the Anima, follow the Pulse, and let the tarot decide your fate, push deeper for rare loot, or rot before you escape. Stray from the Pulse and the darkness will collect what you owe.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.0 GHz / AMD equivalent (dual-core)
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / DirectX 11 compatible
